page.layout: One printed page on the scan: an engraved bookplate (coat of arms with the legend "Academiæ Cantabrigiensis Liber") with a manuscript shelf mark, and a library stamp. On the right edge a fragment of another page with running text (margin cut off, partly visible lines beginning "ex", "Ph", "mi", "for", "utr").
page.notes: The page is the Cambridge University Library bookplate, engraved, with the legend "Academiæ Cantabrigiensis Liber" beneath the arms. Handwritten shelf mark "13-8" below it and a Cambridge University Library stamp are not printed text and are omitted. The left-edge text and the cut-off strip on the right belong to the neighbouring page (show-through or edge), and are not transcribed. No running text or page number is printed on this page.
